name: Tarlatamab (DLL3-targeted BiTE for Relapsed/Refractory ES-SCLC)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS Landmark Regimen: DeLLphi-301 Phase II Trial / FDA approval 2024

premedications.name: Dexamethasone
premedications.notes: Premedication prior to Step-up doses (Cycle 1 Day 1 and Cycle 1 Day 8)

supportiveCare: Inpatient monitoring: 24-48 hours observation required for Cycle 1 Day 1 (1 mg step-up) and Cycle 1 Day 8 (10 mg step-up) due to CRS / ICANS risk.
Tocilizumab (8 mg/kg IV) and dexamethasone must be immediately available on unit before starting infusion.
monitoring: Vitals and neuro checks q2-4h during inpatient step-up dosing
CBC, CMP, ferritin, CRP baseline and prior to each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Administer oxygen; give tocilizumab 8 mg/kg IV (max 800 mg). Withhold tarlatamab until CRS resolves.
Administer dexamethasone 10-20 mg IV q6h. Withhold tarlatamab until complete resolution.

drugs.name: Tarlatamab-dlle
drugs.notes: Tarlatamab maintenance 10 mg IV every 14 days (Cycle 2+). Note: Cycle 1 uses step-up dosing: 1 mg IV Day 1, 10 mg IV Day 8, with required 24-48h inpatient telemetry/monitoring for CRS.
